item.text: A second defect is now observed: `testing.go:609` (`EnsureLeader`) — my §3.5 suspicion. Let me capture the context.

The final suite run surfaced a **second concrete defect**, which promotes my earlier suspicion to an observation:

**Finding 2 (observed):** `(*cluster).EnsureLeader` (`testing.go:589-609`) performs a single, non-retrying leader-agreement check. In `TestRaft_FollowerRemovalNoElection` it failed with `testing.go:609: at least one peer has the wrong notion of leader` (`audit/final-suite.log`). The test restarts a follower, waits only a fixed 250 ms, then asserts every peer already agrees on the leader — a restarted node may not have re-learned it yet, so the assertion is timing-dependent. Same "helper has no retry" class as Finding 1.

Both findings and the full evidence are now in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-08_13-11-14-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md): Finding 1 (`EnsureSamePeers` stale `peerSet`, reproduced + root-caused + fix verified) and Finding 2 (`EnsureLeader` non-retrying, now observed). No defect was found in the core consensus/agreement logic; the artifact is byte-identical to upstream v1.7.3. Evidence is preserved in `work/audit/` (18 logs) plus `audit_diag_test.go`; `source/` untouched. The audit budget is now exhausted.
